_comment: Cau hinh dong san vao bo cai DF Agent - CAN NHO (duoi 6kg, man hinh /weighing-station-v2). Vai tro DUY NHAT: NHAN CAN. Tu 2026-07-31 may in khong con di qua Agent nua (Print Station va Weighing Station deu in bang hop thoai in cua trinh duyet), nen Role co dinh SCALE_ONLY va khong con muc Printer.
_comment_tach_2_bo: Tu 2026-08-03 co HAI bo cai HOAN TOAN DOC LAP: can nho (file nay) va can to (appsettings.large.json). Khac nhau o dung 4 thu: Service:Name, Workstation:ScaleKind, thu muc cai, va UpgradeCode cua MSI. Nho vay cai ca hai len CUNG mot may van chay song song duoc - hai service rieng, hai thu muc rieng, hai ma tram rieng, hai hang doi offline rieng (agent_cache.db nam trong thu muc cai). Go bo mot ban khong dung gi toi ban kia.
_comment_service: Ten service Windows. PHAI khop ServiceInstall/@Name trong DFAgentSetup.wxs (bien ServiceName luc build), neu khong ten trong log lech voi ten SCM.
_comment_backend: Urls = DANH SACH backend nhan so can, Agent day len TAT CA (moi backend mot nhip rieng, khong cho nhau - xem DaySoCanToiCacBackend trong Worker.cs). Vi sao tung co nhieu dia chi (2026-08-03): frontend suy ra host API tu chinh URL trinh duyet dang mo (axios.defaults.baseURL = http://<hostname>:8500, xem frontend/src/main.ts), nen mo man hinh can bang 'localhost:3001' la hoi backend chay ngay tren may do, con mo bang '10.0.60.209:3001' la hoi backend tren CS-SERVER - HAI kho cache tach roi.
_comment_backend_bo_localhost: 05/08/2026: da BO 'http://127.0.0.1:8500/api' khoi bo cai MAY TRAM. May tram khong chay backend cuc bo nen dia chi do khong bao gio song: moi 200ms lai ton mot ket noi hong va Event Log luon co mot dong 'backend hong' khong bao gio het. THEM LAI DONG DO neu cai Agent len chinh may CO chay backend (may dev, hoac CS-SERVER) va mo man hinh can bang localhost - nếu khong thi so can day len backend CS-SERVER trong khi trinh duyet lai doc cache cua backend cuc bo, man hinh se bao mat tin hieu du Agent chay ngon.
_comment_backend_cs: Da kiem chung 2026-08-01: 10.0.60.209:8500 nhan ket noi TCP va tra 401 tren /api/devices/readings (endpoint ton tai, doi xac thuc); dia chi cu 10.0.200.248 KHONG ping/TCP duoc - Agent cai theo cau hinh cu se doc duoc can nhung khong gui duoc so nao len he thong. Khoa cu 'Backend:Url' (chuoi don) van duoc doc lam du phong cho may da cai ban Agent cu.
_comment_workstation: Id DE TRONG CO CHU Y (tu 2026-08-01): Agent tu sinh ma tram tu TEN MAY, thanh 'WS-SCALE-<TEN-MAY>' voi ScaleKind=SMALL. Nho vay cai dung bo MSI nay len bao nhieu may cung duoc, moi may ra mot ma khac nhau, KHONG phai sua tay tung may sau khi cai. Truoc do file nay dong cung 'WS-WEIGH-SCALE' cho moi may nen hai tram can chay cung luc ghi de so can cua nhau. Backend tu tao ban ghi tram cho ma moi ngay o lan day so dau tien (AgentAuth, suy loai tram tu Role + ScaleKind), va trinh duyet tren chinh may do tu nhan ra tram cua minh qua /api/workstations/whoami?kind=SMALL. Chi dien Id tuong minh khi muon ep may nay mang dung mot ma tram co san.
_comment_scalekind: ScaleKind=SMALL giu nguyen tien to ma tram 'WS-SCALE-' cua ban cu - CO Y: doi tien to la moi may pilot dang chay tu sinh ra mot tram moi, bo lai tram cu thanh rac trong DB.
_comment_local: ADR-013 (07/08/2026) - DUONG CAN CUC BO. Agent mo mot endpoint HTTP CHI NGHE tren 127.0.0.1, trinh duyet tren CHINH may nay doc so can thang o do thay vi vong qua backend. Ly do: Agent doc can moi 10ms nhung di qua backend thi con so phai cho hai lan nhip (Agent day 200ms + man hinh hoi 200ms) cong hai chang mang qua mot backend xu ly tuan tu, tong 400-900ms; doc thang con ~70ms, ngang ban Excel VBA. Duong cu VAN GIU NGUYEN lam du phong - Agent van day so len backend y nhu truoc.
_comment_local_cong: Port PHAI khop CONG_AGENT_CUC_BO trong frontend/src/composables/useScaleFeed.ts (SMALL=8770, LARGE=8771) - trang web khong doc duoc file nay nen do la QUY UOC hai ben tu biet. Hai bo cai chay song song tren cung mot may nen bat buoc khac cong. Dat Enabled=false neu muon quay ve hoan toan duong backend.
_comment_local_sse: Tu 4.4.0.0 (07/08/2026) co THEM duong /weight/stream (SSE): Agent TU DAY so moi khi doc duoc so moi, thay vi de trinh duyet hoi vong moi 25ms. Bo duoc khoang nam cho toi luot hoi (trung binh 12ms) va 24/25 lan hoi thua. Duong /weight (hoi vong) VAN GIU nguyen lam du phong va de kiem tra nhanh bang curl. Cung mot cong, cung cong tac Local:Enabled - khong co cau hinh rieng.

Scale._comment_source: Source=PUTTY_LOG: doc duoi file log PuTTY tai LogFilePath - DUNG CACH HE EXCEL VBA CU VAN CHAY O XUONG (yeu cau nguoi dung 2026-08-01). Doi thanh SERIAL neu muon Agent mo thang cong COM. LUU Y: che do PUTTY_LOG doi hoi PuTTY phai dang chay va da bat Session Logging ghi dung vao D:\scale\putty_log.txt. Agent KHONG tu bat PuTTY; neu PuTTY tat thi man hinh can se bao 'MAT TIN HIEU CAN'.
Scale._comment_nhip: ReadIntervalMs=10 la nhip DOC (bang dung VBA StartFastLoop) - quyet dinh do nhay cua StableFilter: 'on dinh' = 2 lan doc lien tiep giong nhau = 20ms. PushIntervalMs=200 la nhip DAY len backend, moi lan la 1 HTTP request nen day moi la thu dat. Hai nhip nay tach roi tu 2026-08-01; truoc do dung chung PollIntervalMs=500 khien phai danh doi giua do chinh xac va tai mang.
